page.overview:
Who is Chilantaisaurus?

is an extinct genus of theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous in what is now China, found within the formation of Ulanshuai. Its classification is unsure, but it is considered that it may be a neovenatorid. There is only one species, C. tashuikouensis, being described by Hu in 1964. The name of this dinosaur comes from the Jilantai Salt Lake, where the species was discovered.

Chilantaisaurus is an obtainable dinosaur from the Jurassic World: Rebirth collection.

Chilantaisaurus is mentioned in the entry of Psittacosaurus as its enemy. However, Psittacosaurus lived before Chilantaisaurus existed.
